articles.content:
Daniel Larson wanted to be famous more than anything, and the internet made him one of its biggest lolcows instead.

After losing his grandmother Nancy and his dog in the same year, Daniel started posting on TikTok in 2019 with one plan: pretend he was already famous until he actually was. It worked, but the audience he found was trolls. They posed as managers and record label scouts, convinced him he was dating singer Grace VanderWaal and running for president, and pushed him to say and do things that got him banned again and again. Then one of those "managers" went digging through his accounts, and what he found changed how everyone saw Daniel.

From there it was meltdowns, group homes, homelessness in a Colorado winter, fake nuke warnings, a cease-and-desist from Grace's own mother and more than eight arrests, until a string of bomb threats ended with a federal case in 2024. After over two years behind bars, he was released in July 2026. This is the full story of how he got here, and the little hope he has left.
